_doc: Sail leech surfaces (docs/kb/art/creatures/act1/sail_leech.md): one carapace slot, the Undertow-spawn's wet lacquer black, with the spawn_wound slits and eyes glowing from their mask (brighter and steadier since the Act I audit: on the Ch4 derelict at night the slits are what draw the kite against the dark deck). write_materials.py on game/shaders/creature/creature.gdshader.
